title: Specmetry gaps v1
description: Output of `specmetry gaps --json`: the gap list of status.v1 with its evaluation context. Invariant: delivery_status is 'ready' if and only if no gap has blocking=true. evidence_grade is always present so that a ready judgement is never shown without its evidence grade. Derived from the same complete input as status.v1 (data-model §6.13.1): the facts of project.id up to as_of_seq, which stay in that project's database (this output is not a backup of them), and the current-value inputs recorded here (snapshot, sources[].current_sha256, the project settings). The workspace context is not an input of gaps. A replay never fills a missing value with a current one.

project.description: The project, and the project settings this derivation used, read once per command (as status.v1 project). Only these settings are output.

sources.description: One observation for each source in the source set at as_of_seq, as used by this derivation; current_sha256 is null when the file was missing.
